notes: The assertions do not separate the two skills: 31 of 32 pass on both. The one baseline failure is eval 1, where its sync trigger rebuilds name from NULL parts and loses the original.

The difference shows up in correctness beyond the assertions. Graders found a wrong rollback-safety claim (eval 0), an irreversible Rails migration (eval 2) and a wrong gh-ost NULL claim (eval 3) in the baseline. The new skill's errors were an overstated CI claim, an imprecise attmissingval description, a Django NOT NULL misstatement and a 30s statement_timeout that would abort a 40M-row VALIDATE.
The statement_timeout finding traces to the skill: operational-mechanics recommends 30s with no exception for VALIDATE or concurrent index builds. Fix in iteration 2.
The narrowing wording traces to the skill too: PostgreSQL ALTER COLUMN TYPE rejects over-length values instead of truncating. Fix in iteration 2.
The new skill costs about 25% more tokens and 64% more time per run, from reading more references and writing longer plans.
Next iteration needs discriminating assertions: correctness of the sync logic, timeout scoping, NULL handling before a NOT NULL rebuild.
